messages.text: I booked our train tickets for the trip to Kyoto.
Ehh?! Already? What time are we departing?
The train leaves at 8:15 AM on August 22nd.
That is so early... Which seats did you get?
Car 4, seats 12A and 12B. Cost was 28,000 yen total.
Mm. Window seat is mine, right?
Yeah, 12A is yours. Also, hotel check-in is at 3 PM at Hotel Anteroom.
Got it! What about lunch after we arrive at 10:45 AM?
I thought we could try that ramen place near the station, Honke Daiyaku.
Ooh! Sounds perfect. I'll pack light then.
Great, just bring one backpack each.
Understood! One backpack it is.
I'll pick you up at your place at 7:30 AM on the 22nd.
Okay, don't be late!

messages.text: Hey Yuna, I got my performance review scores back today.
Ah... how did it go? Are you feeling okay?
Overall I got 4 out of 5.
That's wonderful! ...Wait, is there a but?
Yeah, my manager Dan gave me 3 in presentation skills.
Mm, I see. What did Dan suggest?
He wants me to take a workshop before the Q3 review in September.
That sounds like a constructive idea. Have you found any suitable workshops?
Found two online. One is a 2-day course on April 14-15 for $450.
And the second option?
A 4-week weekend course starting May 3rd for $600.
Ehh... $600 is quite expensive. Does the company cover training costs?
Yes, annual budget is $500 per person.
Ah! Then the $450 one fits perfectly within the $500 budget!
True. The April one covers public speaking and slides design.
Which dates were those again?
April 14th and 15th, from 9 AM to 4 PM.
Will you need to submit a form to Dan?
Yes, form TR-102 needs to be turned in by March 20th.
Okay. Let's make sure you complete TR-102 this week.
I'll fill it out tonight and send it tomorrow morning.
Good plan. Take your time with it.
Also Dan said my project delivery score was 5 out of 5.
Ehh?! Top marks for delivery! See, you did amazingly well!
Thanks Yuna. I feel better now.
I'm glad. Let me know when Dan signs off on the form.
Will do!

target: The user received a 4 out of 5 on their performance review from manager Dan, including a 5 out of 5 in project delivery and a 3 in presentation skills. Dan asked the user to take a presentation workshop before the September Q3 review. The user chose a 2-day workshop on April 14-15 costing $450, which fits within their $500 company training budget. The user agreed to fill out form TR-102 tonight and send it to Dan tomorrow morning before the March 20th deadline.

messages.text: Rin, I need help budgeting for my apartment move.
Hmph. Finally realized how broke you'll be?
Hey! Move date is May 1st.
Fine, tell me the numbers.
Monthly rent is $1,200. Security deposit is $1,200.
So $2,400 up front just for the place. Next?
Movers quoted me $650 for moving day.
Did you check other moving companies?
Yeah, Swift Movers quoted $800, so $650 from City Express is cheaper.
Mm. Make sure that includes packing boxes.
Boxes are extra, $50 for 20 boxes.
Get the boxes by April 10th so you aren't packing last minute.
Good idea. Also internet setup fee is $70 with FiberCo.
What's the total initial payout?
Rent + deposit $2,400, movers $650, boxes $50, internet $70. Total $3,170.
How much do you currently have saved in your moving fund?
I have $3,500 saved in account #4092.
Hmph. So you have a $330 buffer left. Don't spend it on takeout.
I won't! I'll order the boxes on April 10th like you said.
Good. And schedule City Express for 8 AM on May 1st.
Will call them tomorrow to confirm 8 AM.
Don't forget.
I won't. Thanks Rin.
...You're welcome, dummy.

I'll keep my 45-minute Anki routine in the evening too.

messages.text: Shiori, I'm thinking of starting a small home garden.

Yeah. My balcony gets about 6 hours of sunlight daily.
...Six hours is good for herbs and small veggies.
I bought 3 pots, 20 liters of potting soil for $15, and seeds.
...What seeds did you choose?
Basil, cherry tomatoes, and mint. Seed packets cost $9 total.
...Mint grows fast. Keep mint in its own pot.
Oh, good tip! Pot #1 basil, Pot #2 tomatoes, Pot #3 mint.
...Yes. How often will you water them?
I was thinking every morning at 8 AM.
...Morning is best before the heat.
The tomato seeds say germinating takes 7 to 14 days.
...Patience is needed. Keep soil moist.
I'll plant everything this Saturday, August 29th.
...Let me know when the first sprouts appear.
I will! Total spent so far is $42 including the pots.
...$42 for a green balcony is nice.
I'll post photos when they sprout.
...I'll be looking forward to them.
Setting a reminder for Saturday 9 AM to plant.
...Good plan.

The companion advised planting mint separately in its own pot. The user will plant basil in Pot 1, tomatoes in Pot 2, and mint in Pot 3 on Saturday at 9 AM, watering daily at 8 AM. Ski rental package is 4,500 yen per day at Rhythm Japan.
Reserve the gear online in advance or they'll run out of size 28.
Good call. I wear size 28 boots, so I'll book right now.
Are you taking the Shinkansen from Tokyo Station?
Yes, taking the 7:00 AM Hokuriku Shinkansen to Nagano Station.
Ticket is around 8,000 yen one way. Return ticket booked?
Not yet, returning on Feb 16th at 6 PM train.
Book the return train before Feb 1st, trains fill up.
Alright, I'll book return tickets on Jan 28th.
Don't forget to pack thermal layers.
I bought 2 pairs of Heattech tights yesterday.
Good boy. Anything else missing?
Ski goggles. Mine are scratched.
Borrow Ken's spare pair instead of buying new ones.
I'll ask Ken tonight!
Hmph. Save your money for hot hot springs after skiing.
